This is the Brainstorming Area on Lower Ground Floor in Innovation Wing, A wide-angle interior photograph of a modern, flexible learning/makerspace or collaborative classroom. The room is brightly lit with many long rectangular LED light panels mounted at varied angles on an exposed black ceiling with visible HVAC ducts, conduit and cabling. The floor is covered with low-pile carpet in narrow grey stripes. The overall color palette is neutral greys and whites with accent colors in teal, green and primary-tone seating.

Foreground and center:
- Multiple white, moveable rectangular and trapezoid tables arranged in loose clusters across the open floor; most tables have two to four mid‑back grey plastic chairs with metal legs pushed up to them. Some tables sit on castors.
- A few loose papers and small signs lie on tabletops; an orange extension cable snakes across the floor toward the left side of the image.
- In the very front right is a small white shelving unit containing paper, folders and a few small items.

Left side:
- A long workbench runs along the left wall beneath tall windows. On the bench there are several pieces of equipment — at least one laptop, a pair of headsets or cameras, and other small electronics/tools — suggesting a tech workbench or maker-station.
- Immediately inside the room beside the bench is a tall vertical metal structure (looks like an industrial rack or vertical storage/test rig) with multiple horizontal shelves or trays visible through metal framing.
- Near the left rear there is a yellow hard hat or safety helmet placed on a surface.

Background / rear:
- A glass-railed staircase or escalator rises toward a mezzanine/upper level at the back center-left. Suspended under the mezzanine is a small model airplane (red and white), hung near the stair opening and visible against darker upper-level space.
- The back wall is lined with bulletin boards and posters: multiple framed prints, notices and informational sheets are mounted in a gallery-style arrangement (text on them is visible as blocks but not readable at this resolution).
- A projector is mounted from the ceiling on a retractable scissor-lift-style bracket, positioned above the tables.

Right side:
- A stepped seating/bleacher area built into the right wall is upholstered in layered shades of blue and teal; in front of it are colorful rectangular soft ottomans in red, orange and yellow that form an informal seating zone.
- Vertical ribbed acoustic panels or decorative fins in a mint/teal color accent the upper right wall area.

Other notable details:
- The space is empty of people in this shot; no identifiable faces are present.
- Safety/warning signage and small laminated notices are visible on the glass guardrails and some surfaces (specific wording is not legible in the image).
- The room has a clean, organized, multi-use layout — configured for small group work, workshops or presentations — with visible emphasis on technology, flexible furniture and collaborative zones.

Overall composition:
- The photo is taken from one corner looking diagonally across the room, capturing the workbench and industrial rack on the left, the central cluster of tables and chairs, and the stepped seating and colorful lounge blocks on the right, with the staircase/mezzanine and suspended model airplane providing a focal point in the mid-background. The combination of exposed ceiling, bright angled lighting and modular furniture conveys a contemporary campus makerspace or active learning commons.

This is Open Event Area on Lower Ground in Innovation Wing. Interior view of a modern university innovation space — an empty, brightly colored common area that reads as a collaborative learning / exhibition zone. The scene is dominated by tiered seating and a bold wall sign identifying the space.

What is shown and overall layout
- Foreground: a long low wooden bench runs across the lower frame, topped with several padded seat cushions in shades of teal and blue. The bench sits on a neutral, striped low-pile carpet.
- Middle ground: a stepped, multi-level platform rises behind the bench. Each tier has a wood-grain front and white risers; small electrical sockets are visible recessed into the vertical faces of the tiers, indicating the area is set up for laptop use or presentations.
- Background/feature wall: a large geometric wall installation made of three overlapping blue parallelogram panels bears white block text reading "HKU" (on the upper small panel) and the larger slanted words "ENGINEERING" and "INNOVATION" across the two bigger panels. The panels are various blue tones and are mounted on a darker blue backing that contrasts with the pale wall behind.
- Left side and further background: beyond the platform there is an open workspace and circulation zone. A glass-and-metal staircase with a red underside and green-tinted glass balustrade leads to an upper level. Near the base of the stairs are work tables and chairs, cabinetry, and several printed notices or posters affixed to the cabinet fronts. A countertop area with small equipment or dispensers is visible against the back wall.

Key objects and materials
- Upholstered cushions: rectangular seat pads in teal and blue on the bench; a cluster of square pouf-type cushions to the left in a warm gradient — yellow, orange, red — providing accent color.
- Wood-veneered tiers and benches with visible support cubbies under the bench.
- Large blue three-piece sign with white text (HKU / ENGINEERING / INNOVATION).
- Glass stair structure with metal handrails and red-painted stairwell underside.
- Small cabinets and a countertop area with notices and what appear to be a water dispenser or small appliances.
- Multiple recessed electrical outlets on the stepped seating faces.

Color and lighting
- A pastel-dominant palette: mint-green walls and vertical slatted elements, pale lavender/purple ceiling soffit, deep and mid-tone blues on the feature sign and seating, with warm accent cushions in yellow/orange/red.
- Even indoor lighting with no strong shadows — the space appears evenly lit by overhead fixtures or diffused daylight, emphasizing the bright, contemporary aesthetic.

Signage and text
- Clear visible text on the central installation: "HKU" (small panel) and the larger words "ENGINEERING" and "INNOVATION" (white capital letters on blue panels). Additional smaller printed notices and labels are posted on the cabinets at left but are not legible from this distance.

People / activity
- No people or animals are present in the image; the space appears unoccupied and ready for use (group seating, presentations, or casual study).

Location context and function
- Visual and textual cues identify this as an engineering innovation area associated with HKU (The University of Hong Kong). The combination of tiered seating with power outlets, informal benches and poufs, adjacent workspace and staircase suggests a multi-use communal area for workshops, student collaboration, presentations or informal gatherings within an academic building.

Composition and framing
- The photo is composed to show the progression from foreground seating to mid-level presentation tiers and the branded feature wall, with the left side revealing circulation and workspace elements. Strong horizontal lines (benches, tiers, ceiling soffit) and angular geometric signage create a structured, contemporary architectural feel.

This is Open Event Area on Lower Ground in Innovation Wing. A wide-angle interior shot of a modern multipurpose collaboration / presentation space with a clean, contemporary design and muted pastel color palette. The room is empty of people; the focal elements are modular seating, stepped tiered benches, a large video screen with a lectern, and a glazed meeting room at the rear.

Key objects and layout
- Foreground seating: Three parallel rows of low rectangular upholstered ottomans arranged on the left foreground. Each row is a single color block — front row deep orange-red, middle row bright orange, rear row yellow — forming a bright warm gradient that contrasts with the cooler room tones. The ottomans are cube-like, with simple straight edges and cloth coverings.
- Raised tiered platform/audience steps: Center-left a stepped amphitheater structure rises in several wide tiers. The tiers are finished in alternating finishes of light natural wood, navy blue, and pale grey, creating geometric horizontal bands. A narrow teal-blue cushioned bench runs along the front edge of the low tier closest to the camera.
- Large video wall and lectern: On the right side a tall, bright LED screen displays a close-up of a masked individual speaking (no identity given). In front of the screen stands a white perforated lectern or podium with a laptop and cables, indicating the area is used for presentations or talks.
- Back glass partition: Directly beyond the tiers is a full-height glass wall/partition with double doors leading to a separate meeting room or corridor. Notices and printed signs are posted on the glass/doors; faint furniture (tables and chairs) is visible through the glazing. Near the glass enclosure a few utility items (a small red cone or fire-safety object) sit on the floor behind the glass.
- Left utility counter: Along the far left wall there is a low cabinet/counter area with a microwave or appliance, a sink, a yellow cleaning bottle and an "ATTENTION" safety sign mounted above the counter. Vertical mint-green slatted panels rise from the counter area partway to the ceiling as a decorative divider element.
- Ceiling and lighting: The ceiling is an exposed industrial style with visible ductwork, piping and black-painted services. Large rectangular recessed or suspended light panels provide bright, even illumination; some ceiling elements are reflected in the glossy top of the tiered structure.
- Flooring: The main floor is carpeted in a neutral light-beige with fine linear patterning (stripes running roughly toward the back glass). The very front edge of the image shows a smooth bluish tile or painted concrete strip where the carpet begins.

Colors, materials and design details
- Overall color scheme mixes pastel mint-green on the upper walls and slatted divider, cool blues on the tiers and bench cushion, natural light wood on some tier faces, and high-contrast warm seating in oranges and yellows. The combination gives a lively yet professional atmosphere.
- Materials include upholstered fabric (ottomans and bench), laminated or painted wood panels (tier faces), glass (rear partition), metal mesh/perforated paneling (lectern), and exposed metal HVAC components overhead.
- Graphic detail: A triangular blue wall graphic on the tiered structure contains partial white lettering; visible fragments appear to read something like "INNOVAT..." (suggesting an innovation/branding theme), but the full word is not shown in-frame.

Scene context and use
- The layout and furnishings indicate a multi-use learning, briefing or event space — suitable for informal talks, workshops, team presentations, small audiences, or casual group collaboration. The tiered seating provides stepped sightlines toward the video wall and lectern.
- The room is tidy and ready for use; there are no people present in the photographed area. Lighting is cool-white and evenly distributed, accentuating the room’s clean lines and color contrasts.

Visible text and signage
- A safety sign above the counter reads "ATTENTION" in red caps (small text underneath is not legible from this view).
- Printed notices are affixed to the glass partition and to the door, but their content is too small to read in the photo.
- A partial graphic on the tiered wall includes the fragment "INNOVAT..." suggesting the word “innovation” or similar.

Overall composition
- The photo is composed to show the breadth of the space: left-to-right it moves from utility/counter and decorative slats, across the colorful ottoman rows and tiered seating, to the glazed rear room and the prominent video wall and lectern on the right. The combination of bright accent furniture and soft pastel architectural elements creates a modern, flexible interior intended for collaborative work and presentations.

This is Brainstorming Area on Lower Ground in Innovation Wing. A wide-angle interior view of a modern, multipurpose teaching or workshop room set up for collaborative use. The room is brightly lit by many rectangular LED ceiling panels mounted at varying angles in an exposed ceiling with visible ductwork and conduits; a ceiling-mounted projector unit on a scissor lift is visible near the center. Flooring is low-pile striped carpet across most of the space with a short strip of smooth blue flooring at the near left edge by the entrance.

Layout and furniture
- Multiple modular white work tables with curved, irregular shapes and grey perforated metal modesty panels/legs are arranged in loose clusters across the room. The tabletops have gently contoured edges that allow grouping into small pods.
- Matching grey plastic stackable chairs (some paired with tables, others stacked against a wall) are positioned around the tables. A small stack of extra chairs leans against the left wall near a blue accent panel.
- Near the foreground on the left is a distinctive curved table surface with two support legs; more tables and chairs fill the mid- and background in a staggered layout that supports small-group activity.

Walls, doors and signage
- The walls are predominantly white with a single vertical blue accent stripe near the left-hand doors. A double glass entrance/exit with metal frame sits at the left side of the image; a green illuminated EXIT sign is mounted above it.
- A cluster of printed notices, safety signs and small posters (various colors including blue, orange and yellow) is mounted on the wall near the entrance/blue panel. Additional posters and informational boards are visible on the right wall near the shelving.

Equipment, shelving and objects
- Along the right wall are tall, open metal shelving units with many small cubby-like compartments and slots, suggesting storage for projects or materials. A couple of model aircraft are suspended from the ceiling toward the upper-right quadrant — one with red and white wings prominent in the foreground and another pale-colored model behind it — giving the room a hands-on or hobby/engineering feel.
- On one of the tables near the right side there is an orange cable reel and various small items, papers and signs indicating active project or preparation for an event.
- A tall grey storage cabinet or refrigerator and other storage bins are visible along the back wall, along with a small cart on wheels at the far right front corner.

Colors and materials
- The overall palette is neutral and utilitarian: white walls and tabletops, grey chairs and metal supports, and pale striped carpet. Accent colors appear in signage (blue, orange, yellow), the blue floor strip, and the red/white model airplane.
- Lighting is cool-white and even, creating a clinical but functional atmosphere.

Scene composition and context
- The photograph shows an empty room with no people present, arranged and ready for group work, classes, a makerspace session, or a small event. The mix of modular furniture, heavy storage shelving, technical ceiling fittings (projector lift, lighting), suspended model aircraft and safety/instruction signage conveys a flexible educational or technical workshop environment within an institutional building (e.g., school, university, community workshop or lab).
- The image framing captures the entire main floor area from a near-corner vantage point, allowing a clear view of tables, chairs, storage and the entrance area; the depth of the room and the high ceiling are emphasized.

This is Brainstorming Area on Lower Ground in Innovation Wing. A wide-angle interior photograph of a modern, flexible classroom / makerspace viewed from a corner near the entrance. The room is empty of people and arranged with multiple small group workstations and utility storage along the far wall.

Overall layout and perspective
- Camera viewpoint is from the front-left corner of the room looking diagonally across the space. Foreground shows a curved, modular instructor/desk table; midground contains several cluster-style tables and chairs; background is dominated by storage shelving, cupboards and a display window.
- Flooring transitions from a pale blue smooth surface at the very front/left (near the entrance) to a grey striped carpet covering the main working area.
- Ceilings are exposed and painted dark with numerous long, rectangular LED light panels arranged at angles; visible conduit, ductwork and a suspended motorized projector/lift mechanism hang from the ceiling.

Furniture and objects
- Multiple white tabletops (some curved S-shaped modules in the foreground, others forming hexagonal/cluster group tables in the middle) with grey metal modesty panels and castered metal legs.
- Dozens of matching grey molded plastic chairs with metal legs positioned around the tables; several chairs are stacked against a blue-accent wall at the back-left.
- A low black utility cart on wheels sits in the bottom-right corner of the frame.
- A bright orange cable/reel or similar coiled equipment is resting on one of the tables toward the right side of the room.
- Near the back wall, a tall storage cabinet (light grey) and a variety of small desktop items and posters on stands are visible.

Walls, signage and display
- Left side: a double glass/metal entrance door with a green illuminated EXIT sign above; the EXIT sign includes both English and Chinese characters.
- A vertical blue accent column near the entrance holds multiple printed notices and safety signs (pictograms and text panels) — typical workshop or lab safety/posting area.
- Back/right wall: a large, tall shelving system with many grey plastic storage bins/receptacles neatly arranged in rows. The shelving unit looks like modular storage for components or teaching materials.
- Several posters and laminated instruction/safety sheets are mounted on or leaning against the back wall and a tall clear glass panel/window shows a faint reflection or adjacent room beyond.

Distinctive details and equipment
- A model airplane is suspended from the ceiling on the right side of the image: a small vintage-style biplane with cream and red painted surfaces, positioned above the shelving area as a decorative or instructional display piece.
- Ceiling-mounted projector/lift and scissor-lift style fixture center-top suggests room is AV-equipped for presentations.
- Small desktop signs or laminated cards sit on some tables (likely table IDs or reservation notices).
- A stack of spare chairs and a single blue chair sit against the left/rear wall area beside the safety/posting column.

Color palette and lighting
- Neutral, institutional palette dominated by whites, greys and light blues. Tabletops are white, chairs are grey, carpet is grey-toned striping, and walls are mostly white with a single blue accent stripe.
- Bright, even artificial lighting from many ceiling LED panels creates minimal shadow and a clinical, well-lit work environment.

Atmosphere and likely purpose
- The arrangement, signage, storage bins, AV equipment and model plane suggest a multipurpose educational workshop, makerspace or collaborative classroom used for small-group activities, design/build projects or hands-on teaching.
- The room is tidy and organized with clear circulation space between tables and ready-to-use modular furniture; no people are present at the time of the photograph.
